entries.zh: 看管、留神察看他人所做之事
entries.en: to watch over and keep an eye on what someone does
entries.notes: H 栏『糕志』疑误，M 作 chiông、R 作 chòāng，首音不合，义依西语栏定。

entries.zh: 长进、求上进（在荣誉上胜过他人）
entries.en: to strive to excel others in honour; to advance oneself
entries.notes: H 栏『掌進』疑为『長進』（zhǎngjìn，求上进），与『auentajarse en honra』相合。

entries.en: to be careful and attentive; to take care
entries.notes: 『主細』疑为『仔細』（细心），M 次音 Sèy 正合『細』，西语栏 contento/corriento 亦有[疑]。

entries.zh: 关心、挂念（原条目被涂销，西语栏残缺）
entries.en: to be concerned about, to care for (entry struck through; Spanish text damaged)
entries.notes: 整条涂销圈划，L 栏残，仅 H『關心』与 M/R 对音可辨，故义存而条目不确。

entries.en: diligent and frugal; industrious and thrifty
entries.notes: 西语『desador medida mente』疑为 desmedidamente，与『勤儉』义不合，义依汉字栏。

entries.en: to be cautious and attentive

entries.zh: 看重切要之处、谨慎对待
entries.en: to be careful about what is essential; to mind what matters
entries.notes: 『謹要』疑即『緊要』（要紧），M 首音 quīn 正合『緊』。

entries.en: diligent at heart; to apply oneself earnestly
diligent and circumspect
assiduous, diligent
to attend to with urgency and diligence
entries.notes: R 栏首词左端裁切[残]，且 M/R 两栏词序互倒、另混入 chīn iâu 一词，对音存疑。

entries.en: to be meticulous in what one does; to mind what must be done
entries.notes: R 栏作『ī iī』[残] 与 M 不合，H『細二』不成词，义依西语栏推。

entries.en: method, way of doing; manner of handling a matter
entries.notes: 四栏字面密合，惟与词头『cuidar』语义关联较弱，疑指照料事务之法。

entries.en: to guard, to keep watch; to be on alert
entries.notes: H『方守』疑为『防守』，M 首音 hông 正合『防』，与『estar alerta』相合。

entries.zh: 张持（闽南语）：留心、提防、小心在意
entries.en: to be on one's guard, to watch out; to take heed
entries.notes: M『Tiò tī』即闽南语『張持』，R 栏对音与 M 不合，疑栏位串行。

entries.zh: 当心、留意（汉字栏与对音不合，义难定）
entries.en: to take heed, to be careful
entries.notes: H『發業』与 M『huár g iap』、R『fā nie』均不合，西语栏 cuidad/cuidado 亦有[疑]，义依西语栏。

entries.en: to restrain oneself; to keep to one's own obligation
to set one's heart on; to care with all one's heart

entries.zh: 统率、总领（如君王总揽照料）
entries.en: to command and oversee; to govern overall, as a king does
entries.notes: 西语『corni』疑为『como』；M 栏标[疑]，R 作 zûī 与『率』音不合。

entries.zh: 司业（官名）；引申为掌管、办理所备之事
entries.en: director of studies (official title); to oversee what is in preparation
entries.notes: R『zîng zīet』与『司業』对音全不合，且 M 栏标[疑]，疑栏位错置。

entries.en: to be circumspect in one's conduct; to keep oneself in check
entries.notes: 西语栏止于『y tener』，语义依汉字栏『謹身』定。

entries.en: essential, of vital importance
coriander (cilantro); coriander seed
entries.notes: H 首字『皝』疑误（当作『芫』），M『vān ūy chỳ』近『芫荽子』，R 栏 zòan 音不合。
